# Vijendra Kumar — Portfolio

> Senior Software Engineer specializing in backend systems, real-time applications, Salesforce integrations, and edge-native deployments. This site documents professional work at Apsona and personal projects shipped to production.

## About

Vijendra Kumar is a Senior Software Engineer based in Bangalore, India. Currently at Apsona (Sep 2024–present), previously at Pratishthan Software Ventures (fintech/payment systems) and Tata Consultancy Services.

- Site: https://vijevira.in
- Email: vijevira@engineer.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/vijevira
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/vijevira

## Professional Work

### Apsona for Salesforce
https://vijevira.in/projects/apsona/triggered-merge

End-to-end Triggered Merge: Salesforce Flow → Platform Event → Apex Trigger → AWS API Gateway → Lambda (JWT/HMAC auth) → merge execution → Event Log and Run Result custom objects. Includes replay mechanism, configurable Scheduled Apex cleanup, internal monitoring dashboard, and one-click dry-run health check with Slack/email alerts.

Also: apsona_nexus_svc (Node.js + HashiCorp Vault), PDF pipeline, LWC Merge button, Excel Merge automation, Node.js v8→v18 upgrade, >90% Jest+Supertest coverage.

### Pratishthan — Finacle Payment Systems
SEPA, QCBIP, UAERT real-time interbank transfer systems. RCPI/NCPI SLA compliance, NACH outbound/inbound, SEPA Recall lead-day validation, SWIFT charge calculation.

## Personal Projects

### Zyvora — SaaS Project Management
https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/zyvora
https://zyvora.endra.in

Jira-like SaaS platform: Kanban, sprints, timeline views, multi-tenant RBAC, real-time via Socket.IO, BullMQ notification pipeline. TypeScript monorepo with Turborepo. Frontend on Cloudflare Workers, backend on Render.
Stack: React, Vite, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Drizzle ORM, TanStack Query, Zustand, Docker, Wrangler.

### WatchTower — Scraping & Notification Platform
https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/watchtower
https://watchtower.wasmer.app

Monitors HTML pages, RSS feeds, and JSON APIs for changes; delivers to Discord, Slack, and Telegram via a 3-stage BullMQ pipeline (Monitor → Processing → Delivery). Full-stack on Wasmer.io.
Stack: TypeScript, Fastify, BullMQ, PostgreSQL, Redis, Drizzle ORM, Cheerio.

### Chhakkadi — Indian Card Game Platform
https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/chhakkadi-game
https://chhakkadi.endra.in

Real-time platform for 3 Indian card games: Chhakkadi, Dehla Pakad, Call Break. Bot AI players, server-authoritative rules, dual deployment (Cloudflare Durable Objects + Railway).
Stack: React, Node.js, Socket.IO, TypeScript.

### BlindShare — P2P Secure Sharing Suite
https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/blindshare
https://blindshare.in

Zero-persistence P2P file, text, code, and media sharing. Six tools: BlindDrop (files), BlindText, BlindSnippet, BlindSecret, BlindShow (view-once media), BlindCast (screen share). All data is DTLS-encrypted WebRTC; signaling server holds no payloads.
Stack: React, Vite, TypeScript, Node.js, WebRTC RTCDataChannel + MediaStream. Frontend on Cloudflare, signaling on Faable.

### BlindParty — P2P Watch Party & Video Call
https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/blindparty
https://party.blindshare.in

Small-group (≤6) watch party, video call, and ephemeral group chat over a full WebRTC mesh. Screen share, camera/mic with mid-call renegotiation, data-channel group chat. Zero server-side persistence.
Stack: React, Vite, TypeScript, Node.js, RTCPeerConnection (per-peer full mesh), getDisplayMedia. Frontend on Cloudflare, signaling on Faable.

### Multiplayer Card & Board Games (Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects)

- **Cuff the Bluff** (Liar's Dice, 2–15 players, bot AI): https://cuffthebluff.endra.in
- **Splendor** (board game, 2–12 players, bot AI, procedural SVG art): https://splendor.endra.in
- **Cabo** (card game, 2–15 players, bot AI, Show mechanic): https://cabo.endra.in

All built with TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects (one DO per room), WebSockets.
